english.title: Responsible person for wild / semi-wild equine over 12 months moved for slaughter fail to slaughter within 7 days
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the

(A)_[owner having primary day-to-day responsibility for a wild or semi-wild equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), that was aged 12 months or over and being moved from a designated area to a place for slaughter,]_
(B)_[keeper of a wild or semi-wild equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), that was aged 12 months or over and being moved from a designated area to a place for slaughter and for which the owner did not have primary day-to-day responsibility,]_

failed to ensure that the equine was slaughtered within 7 days of **(..SPECIFY DATE ON STICKER..), the date shown on the sticker attached in accordance with regulation 20(2) of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20(3), 22 and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
